recommended_realization.field: One common source-canvas F across coincident seam points; shoulder transition120px and elbow160px. Same exact field for every affected owner; distal all hands/fingers weight1 independently measured on old Core rest.
recommended_realization.existing_hierarchy: Retain current hierarchy; set q_at_key=P_at_key^-1 F(P_rest*q_rest). Keep topwear untouched to preserve abdomen. Use full parent inverse and include all directly bound key axes.
recommended_realization.point_batches: At public16operations x16landmarks cap, split >256 vertices across two changes in the same atomic rig_deform request. Offline simulate completed first change, recompute full current geometry bounds for second change, then submit both together. Exact per-vertex from/to anchors with selection.indices; no independently normalized brush falloff.
recommended_realization.shared_parent_warp: Feasible alternative if a single warp parents the intended pieces and provides the same canvas map; disable/compensate corresponding old rotation to avoid double motion. Put torso outside its scope or give protected support a real identity region. Current parent insertion has known project key-grid preservation risk, so no hierarchy mutation authorized by this review.
recommended_realization.strict_followup: Compare author indices/world rest arrays with actual Core order before applying. Re-export new MOC, verify0 winding flips/collapses, stretch, seam barycentric error, exact3 protected points, off-key and simultaneous axis poses, then inspect GL screenshots. Geometry API acceptance alone is insufficient.
